id: 14_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Safe Use of
title: 生物安全柜的安全使用
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/14_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Safe Use of.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/14_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Safe Use of/src.py

points.K1: 去污、准备、检查后再开工
points.K3: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅
points.K4: 物品先擦拭消毒再放入
points.K6: 废物容器、锐器盒、纸巾别忘
points.K7: 废物容器按柜子大小选
points.K11: 物品靠后放，不挡后格栅
points.K20: 本课不替代本实验室规程
points.S3: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with its glass front sash and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物安全柜的安全使用。
overlay: 生物安全柜的安全使用

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：擦拭布、分区格子、坐姿小人、向内气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a wiping cloth, a three-zone layout grid, a seated person, and inward airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 擦干净、摆整齐、坐端正、少进出。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在安全柜前，柜内物品堆得乱七八糟，一张大纸盖住前格栅
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a biological safety cabinet; supplies are piled messily inside and a large paper sheet covers the front air grille.
shots.narration: 阿杰站着干活，柜里东西堆成一团。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手臂一会儿伸进、一会儿抽出去拿东西
shots.prompt_en: The young male student keeps pulling his arm out of the cabinet to grab items from a cart and pushing it back in at an angle.
shots.narration: 缺什么就伸手出去拿，进进出出。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，轻轻拍拍阿杰的肩膀，指向被盖住的格栅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over, taps the young male student on the shoulder and points at the covered front grille.
shots.narration: 小研提醒他：格栅盖住，气流就乱了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 安全柜靠气流保护你，要会用。

shots.section_title: 去污、准备、检查后再开工
shots.scene: 小研擦拭柜内台面，另一只手按下面板开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, wipes the cabinet work surface, then presses a switch on the blank control panel.
shots.narration: 柜子去污、准备、检查都做完，
overlay: 去污、准备、检查后再开工

shots.section_title: 去污、准备、检查后再开工
shots.scene: 检查清单三项都打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with three items, each getting a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 才可以开始干活。

shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服，戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buttons her lab coat, puts on safety goggles and pulls nitrile gloves over the cuffs.
shots.narration: 防护用品要和所做的工作相匹配。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套三个图标，旁边一张空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves next to a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 具体穿戴什么，按风险评估来定。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 蓝色吸水垫和一叠纸巾放在推车上
shots.prompt_en: A folded blue absorbent pad with a plastic back and a stack of paper towels on a steel cart. No people.
shots.narration: 有的实验室要求铺一层吸水垫。
overlay: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅

shots.section_title: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 小研把吸水垫平铺在柜内操作区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays the absorbent pad flat on the work area in the middle of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 防止台面污染，也方便清理。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 书架上空白的规程文件夹和风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of blank procedure binders and a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 铺不铺，按风险评估和规程定。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫：按规程铺，不挡格栅
shots.scene: 吸水垫盖住前格栅的图标被红叉划掉；垫子停在格栅后打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a pad covering the front air grille crossed out with a red X, and a pad stopping behind the grille with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 但垫子绝不能盖住前后格栅。

shots.section_title: 物品先擦拭消毒再放入
shots.scene: 小研在推车旁用消毒湿巾擦拭培养瓶外壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the outside of a culture flask with a disinfectant wipe next to a steel cart.
shots.narration: 放进柜子前，物品外表面先擦一遍。
overlay: 物品先擦拭消毒再放入

shots.section_title: 物品先擦拭消毒再放入
shots.scene: 小研把擦好的吸头盒放进柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a wiped pipette tip box into the cabinet.
shots.narration: 一件一件擦，一件一件放。

shots.section_title: 物品先擦拭消毒再放入
shots.scene: 外来的小污点被挡在柜外的图标
shots.prompt_en: Small dirt specks on an item are wiped off before it passes into a cabinet icon, with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 少把外面的污染带进柜里。

shots.scene: 推车上的物品依次进入柜内，柜内摆放整齐
shots.prompt_en: Supplies move from a cart into the cabinet one by one until the inside is neatly arranged. No people.
shots.narration: 开工时一次放齐要用的东西。

shots.scene: 手臂来回进出的箭头图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm going in and out of a cabinet opening many times, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 减少中途伸手进出的次数。

shots.section_title: 废物容器、锐器盒、纸巾别忘
shots.scene: 生物危害废物袋、锐器盒、纸巾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bag with a biohazard warning sign, a sharps container, and a roll of paper towels. No people.
shots.narration: 废物袋、锐器盒、纸巾，别落下。
overlay: 废物容器、锐器盒、纸巾别忘

shots.section_title: 废物容器、锐器盒、纸巾别忘
shots.scene: 小研把锐器盒放进柜内右侧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a sharps container on the right side inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 这些也要在开工前放进去。

shots.section_title: 废物容器按柜子大小选
shots.scene: 宽大的安全柜里放着大号灭菌盘，旁边打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A wide biological safety cabinet with a large autoclave pan inside, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 大号灭菌盘，只适合宽大的安全柜。
overlay: 废物容器按柜子大小选

shots.section_title: 废物容器按柜子大小选
shots.scene: 小柜子里塞进大盘子被打叉；改放小袋架打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small cabinet crammed with a large pan crossed out with a red X; the same cabinet with a small bag holder and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 小柜子改用小号废物容器或袋架。

shots.scene: 俯视图：柜内左浅绿区、中间操作区、右侧橙色区
shots.prompt_en: Top-down diagram of a cabinet work surface split into three zones: a light green zone on the left, a work zone in the middle, and an orange zone on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 摆放要遵循由洁到污的原则。

shots.scene: 清洁物品放在左侧
shots.prompt_en: Clean pipettes, tip boxes and tube racks are placed on the left side of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁物品放一侧。

shots.scene: 废物袋和锐器盒放在右侧
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard waste bag on a holder and a sharps container are placed on the right side of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 废物袋和锐器盒放另一侧。

shots.scene: 小研坐在柜前，在中间操作区操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at the cabinet and works in the middle zone, moving items from left to right.
shots.narration: 中间操作，东西从洁往污走。

shots.scene: 右手图标和左手图标，中间是左右互换的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A right hand icon and a left hand icon with a two-way swap arrow between two layout diagrams. No people.
shots.narration: 右手习惯这样摆，左撇子左右对调。

shots.scene: 安全柜剖面图：前格栅吸入、后格栅吸入的气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Simple cross-section diagram of a biological safety cabinet with airflow arrows going down into the front grille and the rear grille. No people.
shots.narration: 前后格栅是气流的进出口。

shots.scene: 前格栅被纸、手臂、移液器压住的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of paper, a resting arm and a pipette lying on the front grille, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压住格栅，气流一乱，防护就失效。

shots.section_title: 物品靠后放，不挡后格栅
shots.scene: 物品往柜内深处推，离后格栅留一点空隙
shots.prompt_en: Items are slid deep into the cabinet, leaving a small gap in front of the rear grille. No people.
shots.narration: 物品尽量往里放，
overlay: 物品靠后放，不挡后格栅

shots.section_title: 物品靠后放，不挡后格栅
shots.scene: 大瓶子贴住后格栅被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a large bottle pressed against the rear grille, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但别贴住、挡住后格栅。

shots.scene: 小研坐在柜前专注操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits on a chair at the cabinet and works steadily.
shots.narration: 在安全柜里干活，要坐着。

shots.scene: 两个人挤在小柜前的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people crowding at one small cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一个柜子，一次只一人操作。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白风险评估表讨论，旁边一台宽大的安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student review a blank risk assessment form beside a wide biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 确需两人，要用宽柜并做书面评估。

shots.scene: 小研按下椅子调节杆，椅子升高
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the lever under her chair and the seat rises.
shots.narration: 坐下先调椅子高度。

shots.scene: 侧面示意：脸在前窗玻璃后、开口上方
shots.prompt_en: Side view diagram: a seated person's face is behind the glass sash and above the front opening. No people.
shots.narration: 让脸高于开口，在玻璃后面。

shots.scene: 小研手臂伸进柜内，肘部弯成直角
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside the cabinet with her elbows bent at a right angle.
shots.narration: 手臂伸进柜内，肘部约成直角。

shots.scene: 前臂轻搁在柜前部的扶手位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student's forearms rest lightly on the built-in arm rest at the front of the cabinet, not on the grille.
shots.narration: 有的柜子可以把前臂搁在前部。

shots.scene: 疲劳的手臂和腰背图标，旁边是扶手打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tired arm and a sore back next to an arm rest icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间操作，防疲劳、防劳损。

shots.scene: 老李给老式安全柜装上专用扶手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a separate arm rest to the front opening of an older cabinet.
shots.narration: 老式柜子可以加装专用扶手。

shots.scene: 装着扶手的柜子旁，检测仪器和空白检测报告
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet with the arm rest installed, next to an airflow test instrument and a blank test report. No people.
shots.narration: 装了扶手，要带着扶手检测合格。

shots.scene: 小研双脚踩在柜下的脚踏上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rests both feet on a foot rest under the cabinet while seated.
shots.narration: 脚够不着地，就用脚踏。

shots.scene: 腰背挺直的坐姿示意图打勾
shots.prompt_en: A side view diagram of a seated person with a straight back and feet on a foot rest, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 腰背也会更舒服。

shots.scene: 欣欣做出双臂平伸直进直出的动作
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot demonstrates moving both arms straight forward and straight back.
shots.narration: 尽量少进出柜子。

shots.scene: 手臂垂直于开口直进直出，绿色箭头
shots.prompt_en: Side view diagram: arms move straight in and straight out perpendicular to the cabinet opening, with green arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 要进出时，手臂垂直直出直进。

shots.scene: 手臂斜着快速扫出、带出一团雾点的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm sweeping out sideways and dragging a puff of mist toward a face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 斜着扫、猛地抽，会把柜内空气带出来。

shots.scene: 雾点飘到操作者口鼻前的示意，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of mist drifting from the cabinet opening toward a seated person's nose and mouth, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 飘进你的呼吸区。

shots.scene: 小研在柜内脱下手套，放进柜内的废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves inside the cabinet and drops them into the biohazard waste bag inside.
shots.narration: 有的规程要求：出柜前先脱手套，

shots.scene: 小研戴上新手套，再把手伸回柜内
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a new pair of gloves, then moves her arms back into the cabinet.
shots.narration: 回柜前换上新手套。

shots.scene: 柜侧壁的真空阀门和管路
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum valve and tubing on the side wall of the biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用真空管路吸液，要保护好管路。

shots.scene: 管路上串着一个过滤器，后面接收集瓶
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum line with an inline filter, connected to a collection flask on a stable stand. No people.
shots.narration: 管路上要装高效过滤器。

shots.scene: 不用的管口盖上盖帽
shots.prompt_en: An unused vacuum line opening is closed with a cap, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不用的管口，要盖上。

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的本实验室规程文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这一课只是基础，
overlay: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 王老师给几名学生讲解规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank procedure binder to a small group of students in a training room.
shots.narration: 具体做法，以本实验室规程为准。

shots.scene: 柜内右侧放着一台涡旋混合器，电线从后面绕出
shots.prompt_en: A small vortex mixer sits at the back right of the cabinet; its power cord runs neatly along the side wall to an outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的小仪器，能不放就不放。

shots.scene: 仪器放在靠后、靠侧的位置，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cabinet work surface with a small instrument placed toward the back side, away from the front grille, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要放的，靠后靠边，别占操作区。

shots.scene: 电线横压在前格栅上的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power cord lying across the front air grille and hanging out of the opening, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线不能横压格栅、垂出前窗。

shots.scene: 老李检查柜内插座和仪器电线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the cabinet outlet and the instrument power cord for damage.
shots.narration: 插座和电线有破损，先报修再用。

shots.scene: 小研要暂时离开，先停下手中的操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pauses her work at the cabinet and puts down her pipette.
shots.narration: 操作中途要离开，先别急着走。

shots.scene: 盖好所有容器，物品放稳
shots.prompt_en: Tubes are capped and racks are set steadily in the middle of the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 盖好所有容器，物品放稳。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢撤出双手，脱下手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly withdraws her arms straight out and removes her gloves into the waste bag.
shots.narration: 双手慢慢撤出，按规程脱手套。

shots.scene: 柜前挂上空白的使用中提示牌，风机继续运转
shots.prompt_en: A blank in-use sign hangs on the cabinet sash while the blower keeps running. No people.
shots.narration: 风机别关，挂牌提示别人勿动。

shots.section_title: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯
shots.scene: 涡旋混合后的离心管静置片刻，再开盖
shots.prompt_en: A capped tube sits still in a rack after vortex mixing, with an hourglass icon beside it, inside a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 混匀、离心后，静置片刻再开盖。
overlay: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯

shots.section_title: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯
shots.scene: 移液器贴着管壁缓慢放液
shots.prompt_en: A pipette tip touches the inner wall of a tube and releases liquid slowly down the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 移液贴壁慢放，不用力吹打。

shots.section_title: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯
shots.scene: 猛力吹打起泡、液体飞溅的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of forceful pipetting with bubbles and splashing droplets, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用力吹打、起泡飞溅，都要避免。

shots.section_title: 减少气溶胶的操作习惯
shots.scene: 小研把用过的吸头直接打进柜内废物容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ejects a used pipette tip straight into the waste container inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用过的吸头，直接丢进柜内废物容器。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的安全柜旁，身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a neatly arranged biological safety cabinet with five icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 记住这几条：

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在调好的椅子上，柜内摆放整齐，格栅畅通
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on an adjusted chair at the cabinet; items are neatly arranged and both grilles are clear.
shots.narration: 阿杰重新摆好，坐下来认真操作。

shots.scene: 小研在旁边竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gives a thumbs-up beside the young male student.
shots.narration: 柜子用得对，气流才护得住你。

shots.scene: 欣欣在安全柜前挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 下一课，我们讲怎样收尾。
